en: Mathias found me left for dead by the Venture Co. in the Barrens. Had it not been for him, I'd have been prowler fodder.
Yes, I will deliver the orders to Warmaster Garrick!
What do you have for sale?
<Place my hand on the orb.>
I see potential in you $n. Now grab a hammer and some of those scraps, you need a lot of practice.
I am slain!  Summon Verog!

Ah, as the title states I am an assassin for the Scarlet Crusade. I spend my days exterminating high priority targets and nights at the Gadgetzan discotheque. Dancing is my true calling. Assassination just pays the bills.
Him name is Grizzle Halfmane. He in Royal Quarter with Banshee Queen and Dread Lord.
What is happening? Look!
Slay them, my brethren! For the Scourge!
I guess you were hungry! Trok was supposed to have fed you earlier... What has he been doing all this time?
Good luck to you, $n. And don't forget... get that script before finding Gazin.
Warmaster, I have lost my insignia. Could you supply me with a replacement?
Have you seen Petra or Dadanga around?

The Highlord was the lynchpin of the Crusade. Aye, Mograine was called the Ashbringer because of his exploits versus the armies of the Lich King. With only blade and faith, Mograine would walk into whole battalions of undead and emerge unscathed - the ashes of his foes being the only indication that he had been there at all. Do you not understand? The very face of death feared him! It trembled in his presence!
The ruins of Zul'Farrak are located in the northwestern corner of the Tanaris Desert.
If you travel to Cenarion Hold in Silithus, you will find Elder Bladesing.
Arthur Moore in Rogues' Quarter inner ring is one who teach leatherworking.
Tell me again about the mines...
I'm so tired of running, but these bees won't leave me alone!
Falthir, I have lost my Zandalar Predator's Mantle and need a replacement.
Impossible! Stay your attack, mortals... I submit! I submit!

In the last war, tauren fought. Shaman were sent in defense of this world against the Scourge invasion. Most lost their lives. Many were otherwise ripped asunder, their body parts used for foul experiments in that cursed citadel. I mourn their passing but my heart swells with pride at their courage.
Let me grab a spell focus from inside my home here, and then we'll get started!
The Primal Gods serve Hakkar. Turn back now, you stand no chance.
You may leave me here -- I wish to be alone in my final moments.
And now, even those nations that you would have called allies have recoiled and joined forces with us... Yes, old one, do not look so surprised.
Aye, you look the type to be a leader.  Here to organize a guild to fight for the Alliance?
Let the blood spilled here today be a lesson to all who dare encroach upon the territory of the Blackrock Clan!
There must be one around here somewhere...
You need to be friendly with the dwarves of Ironforge before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
Time to die, $C.
We showed that one!
I require training, Grimnur.
Elder Ironband lives in Blackchar Cave in Searing Gorge.

Hey there, $c! Looks like the Horde collected the last of their stuff, and now theirs and ours is being shipped over to Silithus as we speak. I'm told it'll be there in less than $2113w days, and then someone can ring that big gong near the Ahn'Qiraj gates to start the war.
Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.
What's this? A chip in the shard? Finally, a weakness exposed... It won't be long now.
When is pappa coming back from the fights in Warsong? It has been so long...
May I have it, please.
We made it!  Thanks, $n.  I couldn't have gotten here without you.
Attacked! Help get this $n off of me!
